verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB offers a free developer tier: a dev instance with up to 4 vCPU and 8 GB RAM and no credit card required. That gives engineers a free sandbox to develop transformations away from production compute. Supporting this, the docs describe throwaway branches of production data on isolated compute, and CHKit can validate and test schema and pipelines as code before deploying. Missing for 10: no local engine or emulator, no evidence the dev loop is fast, branching is framed around agent runs rather than engineer transformation work, the free tier's limits and workflow are only documented in marketing-level detail, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
